text: Refines D-0322 for #552: TLC's general exception message, 1000, counts as Java memory exhaustion when it reports java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException with a java.lang.OutOfMemoryError cause, after a colon on the same line or the next, in LF or CRLF output. Such a report gets the same single exclusive retry, and the same history, as the memory exhaustion already recognized. Similar text in module or action names, trace values or unrelated exceptions doesn't count. On 2026-11-04, one conformance batch of #445's final gate failed this way with no retry, while all 44 batches whose exhaustion was recognized passed on theirs.
